const item = $input.first().json;

// Transform Outlook raw response to Common Mail Message Schema
const commonMessage = {
  provider: 'OUTLOOK',
  mailbox_address: 'management-bot@eldor.com.tr',
  provider_message_id: item.id,
  provider_thread_id: item.conversationId,
  internet_message_id: item.internetMessageId,
  from_address: item.from?.emailAddress?.address || '',
  from_name: item.from?.emailAddress?.name || '',
  to_addresses: (item.toRecipients || []).map(r => r.emailAddress?.address),
  cc_addresses: (item.ccRecipients || []).map(r => r.emailAddress?.address),
  bcc_visible: false,
  reply_to_address: item.replyTo?.[0]?.emailAddress?.address || null,
  subject: item.subject || '(Konusuz E-posta)',
  received_at: item.receivedDateTime || new Date().toISOString(),
  sent_at: item.sentDateTime || new Date().toISOString(),
  in_reply_to: null,
  references: null,
  labels_or_categories: item.categories || [],
  plain_text_body: item.bodyPreview || item.body?.content || '',
  html_body: item.body?.contentType === 'html' ? item.body.content : '',
  attachment_metadata: (item.attachments || []).map(att => ({
    filename: att.name,
    mime_type: att.contentType,
    size: att.size,
    attachment_id: att.id
  })),
  raw_metadata: {
    importance: item.importance,
    is_read: item.isRead
  },
  source_trigger: 'OUTLOOK_POLLING',
  ingested_at: new Date().toISOString()
};

return [{ json: commonMessage }];
